serial_studio_pro.cli_help:
Usage: /Applications/Serial Studio Pro.app/Contents/MacOS/Serial-Studio-Pro [options] [project]
Flexible data visualization software for embedded devices and projects

Options:
  -h, --help                     Displays help on commandline options.
  --help-all                     Displays help, including generic Qt options.
  -v, --version                  Displays application version
  -r, --reset                    Resets all application settings
  -f, --fullscreen               Launches dashboard in fullscreen mode
  --headless                     Run without GUI (headless/server mode)
  --api-server                   Enable API server on startup (port 7777)
  --api-external                 Allow API connections from other hosts, the
                                 non-interactive equivalent of the "Allow
                                 External API Connections" confirmation. Any
                                 machine that can reach port 7777 may read live
                                 data and send commands once it presents the
                                 token, and the transport is not encrypted: use
                                 it on a trusted network or through a tunnel
                                 only
  --api-token <hex>              Set the API authentication token external
                                 clients must present (>= 32 hex characters)
  --dump-api-schema <file>       Write the API command registry to a JSON file
                                 and exit (SDK generator input)
  -p, --project <file>           Loads the specified project file
  -q, --quick-plot               Enables quick plot mode (auto-detect CSV data)
  -t, --fps <Hz>                 Sets visualization refresh rate
  -n, --points <count>           Sets data points per plot
  --uart <port>                  Specifies serial port (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0,
                                 COM3)
  --baud <rate>                  Sets serial baud rate (default: 9600)
  --tcp <host:port>              Connects to TCP server (e.g.,
                                 192.168.1.100:8080)
  --udp <port>                   Binds to UDP local port (e.g., 8080)
  --udp-remote <host:port>       Specifies UDP remote target (e.g.,
                                 192.168.1.100:8080)
  --udp-multicast                Enables multicast mode for UDP
  --ws <url>                     Connects to a WebSocket endpoint (e.g.,
                                 ws://192.168.1.100:8080/feed)
  --http <url>                   Polls an HTTP endpoint (e.g.,
                                 https://api.example.com/telemetry)
  --http-method <verb>           Sets the HTTP method (default: GET)
  --http-interval <ms>           Sets the HTTP poll interval in ms; 0 sends
                                 only on write (default: 1000)
  --http-header <name: value>    Adds an HTTP request header; repeatable
  --insecure-tls                 Accepts untrusted certificates on wss:// and
                                 https:// endpoints
  --benchmark-hotpath            Run the in-process frame-extraction throughput
                                 benchmark and exit
  --min-fps <fps>                Minimum frames/sec the hotpath benchmark must
                                 sustain (default: 256000)
  --benchmark-frames <count>     Frames to push through the hotpath benchmark
                                 (default: 1000000)
  --benchmark-seconds <seconds>  Wall-clock seconds the hotpath benchmark must
                                 sustain (default: 10)
  --benchmark-output <file>      File to write the hotpath benchmark report to
                                 (default: stdout only, no file)
  --exit-after <seconds>         Quit gracefully after the given number of
                                 seconds (CI runs, PGO training)
  --no-toolbar                   Hides the main window toolbar at startup (Pro)
  --runtime                      Operator runtime mode: hides toolbar, quits on
                                 disconnect (Pro)
  --shortcut-path <path>         Path of the shortcut that launched this
                                 process (Pro)
  --csv-export                   Enable CSV export immediately on startup (Pro)
  --mdf-export                   Enable MDF4 export immediately on startup
                                 (Pro)
  --session-export               Enable historian export on startup (Pro)
  --console-export               Enable console log export on startup (Pro)
  --actions-panel                Show the actions panel in operator runtime
                                 mode (Pro)
  --file-transmission            Allow opening the File Transmission dialog in
                                 operator runtime mode (Pro)
  --taskbar-mode <mode>          Operator-mode dashboard taskbar visibility:
                                 shown / autohide / hidden (Pro)
  --taskbar-buttons <ids>        Comma-separated taskbar pin IDs for operator
                                 mode (Pro)
  --no-taskbar-search            Hide the taskbar search bar in operator
                                 runtime mode (Pro)
  --theme <name>                 Override the application theme by name (e.g.
                                 "Iconic", "Light", "System") (Pro)
  --activate <key>               Activate a license key and exit (for
                                 CI/headless setup)
  --deactivate                   Deactivate the current license instance and
                                 exit (for CI cleanup)
  --selftest-offline-license     Run offline-certificate verifier self-test
                                 vectors and exit (Pro)
  --verify-session <file>        Verify an archived historian database's
                                 reproducibility and exit; prints a JSON verdict
                                 (spec 0044, Pro). Pair with --headless for
                                 offscreen operation
  --verify-session-id <id>       Session id inside the --verify-session archive
                                 (default: latest completed session)
  --verify-keep-regen            Keep the temporary regenerated database for
                                 inspection (Pro)
  --regress-session <file>       Compare an archived session against a
                                 candidate project and exit; prints a JSON drift
                                 report (spec 0047, Pro). Pair with --headless
                                 for offscreen operation
  --regress-session-id <id>      Session id inside the --regress-session
                                 archive (default: latest completed session)
  --regress-project <file>       Candidate project file for --regress-session
                                 (Pro)
  --regress-keep-regen           Keep both temporary regenerated databases for
                                 inspection (Pro)
  --validate-guards              Verify all embedded license guards pass in
                                 this binary and exit (Pro)
  --modbus-rtu <port>            Connects to ModBus RTU device (e.g.,
                                 /dev/ttyUSB0, COM3)
  --modbus-tcp <host:port>       Connects to ModBus TCP server (e.g.,
                                 192.168.1.100:502)
  --modbus-slave <address>       Sets ModBus slave address (1-247, default: 1)
  --modbus-poll <interval>       Sets ModBus poll interval in ms (50-60000,
                                 default: 100)
  --modbus-baud <rate>           Sets ModBus RTU baud rate (default: 9600)
  --modbus-parity <type>         Sets ModBus RTU parity
                                 (none/even/odd/space/mark, default: none)
  --modbus-databits <bits>       Sets ModBus RTU data bits (5/6/7/8, default:
                                 8)
  --modbus-stopbits <bits>       Sets ModBus RTU stop bits (1/1.5/2, default:
                                 1)
  --modbus-register <spec>       Adds ModBus register group: type:start:count
                                 (repeatable)
  --canbus <plugin:interface>    Connects to CAN bus (e.g., socketcan:can0,
                                 peakcan:pcan0)
  --canbus-bitrate <rate>        Sets CAN bus bitrate in bps (default: 500000)
  --canbus-fd                    Enables CAN-FD mode
  --opcua <url>                  Connects to an OPC UA server (e.g.,
                                 opc.tcp://192.168.1.10:4840)
  --opcua-user <name>            Sets the OPC UA username (enables
                                 username/password authentication)
  --opcua-pass <password>        Sets the OPC UA password
  --opcua-interval <ms>          Sets the OPC UA publishing interval in ms
                                 (10-60000, default: 100)
  --opcua-tag <spec>             Subscribes to a tag: nodeId[:type[:name]]
                                 (repeatable, type default f64)
  --s7 <host>                    Connects to a Siemens S7 controller (e.g.,
                                 192.168.0.1)
  --s7-rack <rack>               Sets the S7 rack number (0-7, default: 0)
  --s7-slot <slot>               Sets the S7 slot number (0-31, default: 1)
  --s7-interval <ms>             Sets the S7 poll interval in ms (50-60000,
                                 default: 200)
  --s7-variable <spec>           Polls a variable: address[:name] (repeatable,
                                 e.g. DB5.DBD20:REAL)
  --ethernetip <host>            Connects to an EtherNet/IP gateway (e.g.,
                                 192.168.0.10)
  --ethernetip-path <path>       Sets the CIP routing path (default: 1,0)
  --ethernetip-plc <family>      Sets the controller family (default:
                                 controllogix)
  --ethernetip-interval <ms>     Sets the EtherNet/IP poll interval in ms
                                 (50-60000, default: 250)
  --ethernetip-tag <spec>        Polls a tag: tag[:type[:element]] (repeatable,
                                 type default f32)
  --iec104 <host>                Connects to an IEC 60870-5-104 station (e.g.,
                                 192.168.0.20)
  --iec104-port <port>           Sets the IEC 60870-5-104 port (default: 2404)
  --iec104-ca <address>          Sets the common address of ASDU (0-65535,
                                 default: 1)
  --iec104-k <frames>            Sets the send window k (default: 12)
  --iec104-w <frames>            Sets the acknowledgement window w (default: 8)
  --iec104-t1 <ms>               Sets the send/confirm timeout in ms (default:
                                 15000)
  --iec104-t2 <ms>               Sets the acknowledgement timeout in ms
                                 (default: 10000)
  --iec104-t3 <ms>               Sets the idle-test timeout in ms (default:
                                 20000)

Arguments:
  project                        Project file to open

do_not: Send ASCII/JSON into CDC; host requests are K1S1 binary.
Treat STATUS.md as the resident image.
FFT 5 Hz health fields and call that an audio spectrum.
Let Serial Studio and a runner share 045b:5310.
